project_type: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo - React 18 + Vite frontend, Express.js backend, Prisma ORM + Neon PostgreSQL
build_system: npm scripts with tsc for backend, vite build for frontend. No npm install possible (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network). All dependencies pre-installed.
test_framework: No test framework configured. Validation is via TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit / tsc -b --noEmit).
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/madarek/backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd /projects/sandbox/madarek/frontend && npx tsc -b --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit in backend/ to verify backend compiles. 2. Run npx tsc -b --noEmit in frontend/ to verify frontend compiles. 3. Run npx prisma generate in backend/ after schema changes to regenerate client types.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/prisma/migrations/ - generated by prisma migrate dev. node_modules/.prisma/client/ - generated by prisma generate. Cannot run prisma migrate in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY mode (needs DB connection).
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed. For schema changes: npx prisma migrate dev --name <name> (requires DATABASE_URL). For type generation: npx prisma generate.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. No npm install, no external HTTP. DATABASE_URL env var MAY connect to Neon (check if available). Prisma generate may work if the schema is valid. TypeScript compilation is the primary validation method.
contribution_requirements: All new routes use requireRole('OWNER') middleware. Follow existing patterns: Router().use(authMiddleware).use(requireRole(...)). Use validate() for request validation. Wrap handlers in try/catch with next(e). Use prisma client from db.ts.

key_patterns.backend_routes: Express Router in individual .routes.ts files, imported in app.ts and mounted on /api/v1. Use authMiddleware + requireRole. validate() with zod schemas. Response format: res.json({ data }) or res.json({ data, meta }).
key_patterns.frontend_pages: React functional components in pages/<role>/<Name>Page.tsx. Export barrel in <Role>Pages.tsx. Use hooks from hooks/useOwner.ts with TanStack Query. Components from components/primitives. Lucide icons. Chart.js for charts.
key_patterns.frontend_hooks: Custom hooks wrapping useQuery/useMutation from @tanstack/react-query. API calls via api (axios instance) and unwrap helper.
key_patterns.navigation: Nav items in lib/nav.ts with NavGroup/NavItem interfaces. NAV_BY_ROLE record. Page titles in AppShell PAGE_TITLES. Routes in App.tsx.
key_patterns.styling: Component-scoped classes in styles/owner.css. CSS custom properties from the Stitch design system (--text, --surface-1, --accent, --border, etc).
key_patterns.prisma_schema: Models in backend/prisma/schema.prisma. Migrations in migrations/ folder. Uses cuid() for IDs, @updatedAt, @@index for query patterns.

directory_structure.frontend/src/hooks/: Custom React hooks (API calls via TanStack Query)
directory_structure.frontend/src/lib/: Navigation config, API client, query client
